statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Current Tail remains below the watch threshold despite extreme geopolitical and cross-asset Stress.
recommendation: Current price discovery remains orderly; the principal conditional risk window is the U.S. Treasury Iran-sanctions announcement and its immediate cross-asset aftermath.
headline: Orderly early-Monday price discovery; Iran sanctions remain the main conditional tail-risk window
body: U.S. index futures are near flat and oil is lower ahead of new Iran sanctions details. Hormuz disruption and elevated long-end yields keep Stress extreme, but no persistent one-way NQ structure, failed-retracement sequence, or session-extreme hold is verified.
